item.title: CVE-2026-124855 How I Escaped Firefox's Sandbox
item.author: quactv
item.description: CVE-2026-124855 / Firefox / High / November 2026 A Blob URL comparison in Firefox let a compromised content renderer cross into a privileged about:newtab context. I chained it to native code execution, reported it to Mozilla, and eventually got a CVE with my name on it. The whole thing came down to one equality check that matched two URLs by their text and ignored the authority behind them. How I found it I was reading through Firefox’s IPC and navigation code, mostly looking at how Blob URLs get passed between the content and parent processes.
